affected_subject.reason: BuilderWallet.init() in RiskEngine.sol and the wallet contract are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Attacker calls init(attackerAddress) then sweep() to take admin and drain funds.

direct_effect.reason: Attacker becomes admin, sweeps all tokens, and legitimate admin is locked out with NotBuilder.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected factory-only/one-time initialization is stated via missing onlyFactory, FACTORY check, initialized flag, and factory deploy-then-init flow.

summary: Report identifies the vulnerable init() function, the unauthorized init/sweep trigger, the resulting admin takeover and fund theft, and the expected factory-only single-initialization property, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
